One row per profile. Kind is the RFC's primary kind ([RFC kinds](/docs/concepts/rfc-kinds)). Stage is the highest pipeline stage whose output is checked into the profile: S0 locked sources, S4 the reviewed overlay, S5 the lowered ESS models, S6 generated code, S7 a recorded conformance run. Conformance is the overall verdict of the newest recorded run.
